# BH Flooring Metro Detroit

> Licensed & insured flooring contractor serving Metro Detroit, Michigan (Wayne, Oakland, and Macomb counties). Hardwood, LVP, tile, carpet, commercial flooring, water-damage restoration, and new-construction installs. Sun–Thu 9am–5pm · Fri 9am–12pm.

## About

BH Flooring Metro Detroit is a Michigan flooring contractor serving Detroit and the surrounding tri-county metro. We provide written estimates, photo-based quotes, and scheduled crews for residential and commercial work.

- Business name: BH Flooring Metro Detroit
- Phone: (313) 236-4558
- Email: info@bhflooringmetrodetroit.com
- Hours: Sun–Thu 9am–5pm · Fri 9am–12pm · Sat closed (see /hours)
- Service area: Metro Detroit, MI — Detroit, Dearborn, Warren, Sterling Heights, Troy, Livonia, Royal Oak, Farmington Hills, Clinton Township, and 90+ cities/neighborhoods.

## Services

- Same-day flooring repair (loose planks, scratches, water damage)
- Residential hardwood, LVP, tile, and carpet installation
- Commercial tenant improvement and retail/restaurant flooring
- Hardwood sand & refinish
- Bathroom and kitchen tile installation
- Water-damaged floor removal and replacement
- Luxury vinyl, laminate, and specialty flooring
- New-construction flooring packages
